# RewardSplitter

<!-- generated by scripts/render.mjs from data/ ; do not edit -->

Splits purchaser rewards between the application and shared upside. Both shares stay in RewardVault custody as pot attributions: the recipient pulls its own pot whenever it chooses (`RewardVault.transfer`) or migrates it onward, so delivery imposes no requirement on the recipient beyond pot ownership.

**Address**: [`0xA3637B88246F535e241fd7BE257B1faCB2269CC5`](https://evm.now/address/0xA3637B88246F535e241fd7BE257B1faCB2269CC5?chainId=1)
**Source**: `src/midway/RewardSplitter.sol`
